faqs.q: What is AU Kosmo Credit Card?
faqs.a: AU Kosmo Credit Card is a lifetime free credit card offered by AU Small Finance Bank in partnership with Kiwi. It offers cashback on eligible UPI Scan & Pay, online payment, and shopping transactions, along with fuel and EMI-related benefits.

faqs.q: How much cashback can I earn on UPI payments with AU Kosmo Credit Card?
faqs.a: Cardholders can earn 1.5% cashback on eligible UPI Scan & Pay transactions made through the Kiwi app, and 0.5% cashback on online payments via Kiwi app, along with other offline & online shopping spends.

faqs.q: Is the 1.5% cashback available on all UPI transactions?
faqs.a: No. The 1.5% cashback rate is applicable to eligible UPI Scan & Pay transactions made through the Kiwi app. The cashback rate and eligibility may vary for other types of transactions.

faqs.q: Is AU Kosmo Credit Card suitable for regular UPI users?
faqs.a: Yes. The card can be particularly useful for consumers who frequently make UPI Scan & Pay payments through the Kiwi app, as these transactions offer the highest cashback rate of 1.5% among the card\'s listed cashback categories.

faqs.q: Can I convert AU Kosmo Credit Card transactions into EMI?
faqs.a: Yes. Eligible transactions of Rs. 500 and above can be converted into EMI, subject to a minimum total transaction value of Rs. 2,000 and applicable terms and conditions.

faqs.q: Who should get AU Kosmo Credit Card?
faqs.a: AU Kosmo Credit Card is best suited for consumers seeking a lifetime free credit card that offers cashback on UPI, online and shopping spends, along with basic benefits such as fuel surcharge waiver and EMI conversion.
